sections.Cabal of Winds Temple:
A bright flash of light blinds you and you hear the sounds of combat not far away...A ghostly figure stands between you and the horrors, following some last protective instinct. Adrenaline pumping, you force yourself to your feet!
To begin the quest, players must first get theSaved by ghost at Cabal of Winds Templedefeat scenario, where they will be accompanied byWilliam. This scenario will beguaranteedthe first time you die in the Cabal Temple. This scenariodoes count as a hardcore defeat.
sections.Enmerkar Forest:
Find the ghost "???" at theAbandoned Dockssouth of Berg to officially start the quest.
Perhaps this ghost was tasked with bringing those ashes someplace? In a moment of pity, you take not only the urn, but also the skull of this dead urn-bearer. If you find the destination the urn was intended for, perhaps you can lay these souls to rest...
sections.Ancestor's Resting Place:
Head toAncestor's Resting Place, entering from the main entrance north of Berg.
Walk down the staircase and then take the first left at the fork, into a room with an altar. Interact with the altar here and you will finish the quest and receive the shield.
